detail: HABS CA-41, measurements and drawings by United States Department of the Interior and National Park Service. The two cross sections show the gables, chimney offsets, lens, gallery, dome and elevated door reached by exterior stairs.
National Register records 20 by 30 feet in the original design, sandstone residence, whitewashed brick tower with 10-foot diameter, and a rear wooden kitchen lean-to.
Park locates the standing crest at roughly 422 feet above sea level and the historical Fresnel lens roughly 40 feet above the site.
Park describes the prominent stairs at the center of the long entrance façade and distinguishes the lighthouse residence from the nearby cottage.
Park confirms the separately reconstructed assistant keeper’s quarters and its exhibit function.
